titre: Le marché des puces sur mesure pour l'IA
sous_titre: Chiffre d'affaires de semi-conducteurs pour l'intelligence artificielle du premier fournisseur mondial, en Mds $, trimestres de l'exercice 2026

T1 2026.texte: Q1 AI revenue of $8.4 billion grew 106% year-over-year, above our forecast, driven by robust demand for custom AI accelerators

T2 2026.texte: Q2 semiconductor revenue from AI of $10.8 billion grew 143% year-over-year, above our forecast

T3 2026.texte: Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion grew 221% year-over-year, and 54% quarter-over-quarter

T4 2026 prévu.texte: we expect AI semiconductor revenue to accelerate to $21.7 billion, up 236% year-over-year
